description: This file defines a fragment for an Android TV application using the Leanback library. It constructs a home screen with multiple UI components including a top navigation bar, a hero banner hint, and several content rails with poster cards, aligning with a Figma design theme. The class structures handle UI setup, rendering of navigation pills, banner hints, and poster cards, along with sample data for content.

classes.name: HomeBrowseFragment
classes.description: Main fragment for the home screen, setting up UI components and content rows based on design specifications.

classes.name: TopMenuItem
classes.description: Data class representing an item in the top navigation strip, with label and active state.

classes.name: TopMenuPresenter
classes.description: Custom presenter for rendering each top navigation pill with focus and active styling.

classes.name: HeroBannerHintPresenter
classes.description: Presenter that renders a non-interactive visual banner as a placeholder for highlighted content.

classes.name: SimpleContentCardData
classes.description: Data holder for content cards including title, subtitle, and optional progress indicator.

classes.name: PosterCardPresenter
classes.description: Presenter for creating poster cards with focus effects and optional progress display.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates view holders for various presenters (top navigation pills, banner hint, poster cards).

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to view holders, setting UI states and content.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Handles cleanup when view holders are unbound.
